text:
incident-bot: Pager — P0: kelvin-privnet egress failures observed for tenant `kelvin` (dedicated pool k-priv-1, us-west-2). Errors: increased 502/504 from customer API, started ~03:12 UTC. Notified oncall.

sre-maya: i’m on it, taking pager. starting quick blast radius check.

neteng-kate: seeing asymmetric conntracks on the NATs and repeated TLS handshake resets to 10.7.x/16 -> seems like SG deny churned around 03:10. pulling audit.

sre-maya: confirmed spikes on NLB backend 10.7.3.21:502 causing 502 from ALB -> target health noisy. can someone dump target health?

eng-platform-tyler: running: 
```
aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:...:targetgroup/tg-kelvin
```
TargetHealth: Unhealthy(3/4) with TLS handshake errors and timeout.

support-luis: customer portal shows many 5xx for /v1/encode, they called in, CS alerted. Jordan (acct) is on call with them.

acct-jordan: on call with customer now. they see errors from their app intermittently; said they rolled no changes. asked if we can mitigate quickly.

neteng-kate: audit log: security-group sg-0a1b2c3d had an inline rule updated at 03:09 by automation: removed source range 10.7.0.0/16 for TCP/443. suspect automation rule rollback failed. proposing re-add rule.

sre-maya: agree re-add SG allow from tenant NAT range immediate. small blast: 
```
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-0a1b2c3d --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 10.7.0.0/16
```
Can neteng confirm it's safe?

neteng-kate: safe for tenant-private pool, doing ingress add now. updating...

neteng-kate: added, waiting 30s for conntrack to stabilize. also flushing conntrack on the NATs to free stuck sockets.

eng-platform-tyler: flushing conntrack:
```
for i in nat-*; do ssh $i sudo conntrack -D -p tcp --orig-port-dst 443; done
```

sre-maya: traffic metrics improving, error rate dropping from 34% -> 7% in 2 mins. target health going healthy on 2/4 -> 4/4.

support-luis: customer reports degradation improving. they see 200s again, testing suite passing for basic flows.

acct-jordan: customer very relieved, asked for root cause and permanent fix. will keep them updated. sending reconfirmation email.

eng-platform-tyler: quick follow-up: automation job that pruned SGs had a race with tenancy churn; we will quarantine the automation and create a safer rollout gate. filing infra ticket.

neteng-kate: note: as a safety fallback we prepared a weighted Route53 record to shift 100% traffic to backup NLB (k-priv-1-backup) if this reoccurs. not switching now since fix looks stable.

sre-maya: agree leave as is. starting post-incident timeline and handing off to on-call for next shift. tagging next oncall: @sre-night.

acct-jordan: logged the customer impact, will include timestamps and mitigation steps. customer requested a postmortem and timeline.

support-luis: marking incident P0 in ops board, assigning to ENG-789 (automation-safe-sg-rollout). will coordinate the postmortem and external comms.

incident-bot: Handoff recorded. Incident channel will remain open for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
